description: AICTIONBOT™ weekly status by KULIC Advisory, built on the Execution Toolkit template T01 (CEO dashboard). Takes the week's figures with last week's value and an optional target, or a table of weekly values (one row per week) with targets, and rates each figure by the template rule: above plus 5 percent against last week green, down to minus 5 percent amber, below that red (reversed for figures where lower is better, such as overdue receivables or complaints; the threshold can be changed). Returns the status per figure, the gap to target, the three biggest movers and a question for each red figure. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

metrics.description: Rows: metric, current, previous, target, better (higher or lower), note.

targets.description: Targets per figure name, for weeks.

threshold_percent.description: Change against last week that counts as green or red. Default 5.

weeks.description: Alternative: one row per week, one column per figure; the last two rows are compared.

name: weekly_status
title: Weekly status as a traffic light: each figure against last week and target, what moved most
